metadata.question: Is the tropospheric NO2 concentration higher in a region 50 km west of Pacific Palisades, Los Angeles, California than in a region 50 km southwest of Pacific Palisades on January 7, 2025 afternoon?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Sentinel-5P TROPOMI for NO2 (COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2) - Date: January 7, 2025 (single day) - Location: Pacific Palisades, LA (~34.05°N, 118.53°W) * 50 km west: approximately (-0.45° longitude) → ~118.98°W * 50 km southwest: approximately (-0.32° longitude, -0.32° latitude) → ~118.85°W, 33.73°N 2. Masking strategy: - Use quality flag (qa_value >= 0.75) to filter valid NO2 measurements - Focus on tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density band 3. Logic: - Get mean NO2 for both regions - Valid Zero: NO2 can be legitimately low over ocean - Check if data exists (C1), if pixels exist after masking (C2), if results are valid (C3) - Compare: west_NO2 > southwest_NO2 → A, else → B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Pacific Palisades location and offset regions const palisades_lon = -118.53; const palisades_lat = 34.05; // 50 km west (approximately 0.45 degrees at this latitude) const west_lon = palisades_lon - 0.45; const west_lat = palisades_lat; const west_point = ee.Geometry.Point([west_lon, west_lat]).buffer(5000); // 50 km southwest (approximately 0.32 degrees each) const sw_lon = palisades_lon - 0.32; const sw_lat = palisades_lat - 0.32; const sw_point = ee.Geometry.Point([sw_lon, sw_lat]).buffer(5000); // 2. Get Sentinel-5P NO2 data for January 7, 2025 const collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .filterDate('2025-01-07', '2025-01-08') .filterBounds(west_point.union(sw_point)); const size = await collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Total images found: ${size}`); if (size === 0) { console.log('No Sentinel-5P data available for this date.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Process NO2 data with quality filtering const no2_band = 'tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'; const qa_band = 'qa_value'; function maskQuality(image) { const qa = image.select(qa_band); const mask = qa.gte(0.75); return image.select(no2_band).updateMask(mask); } const no2_image = collection.map(maskQuality).mean(); // 4. Calculate NO2 for west region const west_result = await no2_image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: west_point, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const west_count = await no2_image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: west_point, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); // 5. Calculate NO2 for southwest region const sw_result = await no2_image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: sw_point, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const sw_count = await no2_image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: sw_point, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const west_no2 = west_result[no2_band]; const west_pixels = west_count[no2_band]; const sw_no2 = sw_result[no2_band]; const sw_pixels = sw_count[no2_band]; console.log(`West region - NO2: ${west_no2}, Valid pixels: ${west_pixels}`); console.log(`Southwest region - NO2: ${sw_no2}, Valid pixels: ${sw_pixels}`); // 6. Validation and answer if (west_pixels === 0 || sw_pixels === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels after quality masking.'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (west_no2 == null || sw_no2 == null || isNaN(west_no2) || isNaN(sw_no2)) { console.log('Invalid NO2 calculation results.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Compare NO2 concentrations if (west_no2 > sw_no2) { console.log(`West NO2 (${west_no2.toExponential(3)}) > SW NO2 (${sw_no2.toExponential(3)})`); console.log('A'); } else { console.log(`West NO2 (${west_no2.toExponential(3)}) <= SW NO2 (${sw_no2.toExponential(3)})`); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
